sys_atf_test.description: Calls sn_dt.DecisionTableAPI().getDecisions() against the ITF Request Requirement decision table for every combination of exempt, over_cap and itf_trigger, resolves each answer by re-querying sys_decision_multi_result, and asserts the resulting request_basis. Guards the decision_table binding and the sys_variable_value answer rows, whose loss makes every lookup return nothing without raising an error.
sys_atf_test.name: ITF Request Requirement decision table returns the correct basis for all six input combinations
